# miniz provenance

* Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
* Version: **3.0.2**
* Pinned tag commit: `293d4db1b7d0ffee9756d035b9ac6f7431ef8492`
* Source: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/293d4db1b7d0ffee9756d035b9ac6f7431ef8492
* Download: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/archive/293d4db1b7d0ffee9756d035b9ac6f7431ef8492.tar.gz
* SPDX license: **MIT**. See `LICENSE` and the original notices in each file.

The upstream source/header files and LICENSE are unmodified. Only ZIP reading,
CRC-32 and inflate are built (`MINIZ_NO_STDIO`, `MINIZ_NO_TIME`,
`MINIZ_NO_DEFLATE_APIS`, `MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_APIS`). `miniz_tdef.h` is included because
the upstream umbrella header includes it; no deflate implementation is linked.
`miniz_export.h` is the local static-build equivalent of the export header
normally generated by upstream CMake.

`provenance.json` supplies machine-readable version, URL, SPDX license and a
filename-to-SHA-256 mapping for every vendored source/header/license, including
the locally supplied export header. `SHA256SUMS` contains the same hashes for
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`. The metadata and this document do not hash themselves.
